Because prime-agent print-mode runs route through a daemon, and a shared daemon only pins HERDR_* client env vars — it captures `SECOND_BRAIN_HOME` at its own startup, so your export never reaches it (brainstem/prime-extension/tests/integration/run-integration.sh:11-21; telemetry/SCHEMA.md:70-72; phase9-episodic-design E4).

Integration runs must pass a dedicated `--daemon-socket <unique pipe>` per run so a fresh daemon spawns from the client process and inherits the throwaway home (then shut it down); only production users set `SECOND_BRAIN_HOME` before starting the shared daemon.
